e.body: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts（MIT，TypeScript，2026-08-18 建仓 / 2026-09-04 更新）把三个保险领域专家 agent 封装成 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**并发布到 npm——与本 wiki 所用运行时同源，可直接加载试用：① `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-company-analyst`（v1.0.1）：保险公司财务经营分析，做利润表/资产负债表结构拆解、偿付能力充足率与风险评级跟踪、投资端资产配置与减值、渠道分析与同业对标；② `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-ops-analyst`（v1.0.1）：经营分析（代号「盈安」），五维测算——核心/综合偿付能力充足率、盈利能力、内含价值（EV）、投资风险、监管合规；③ `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-product-analyst`（v1.8.4，2026-09-10）：产品分析与建议书（代号「险析君」），覆盖条款解读、性价比、产品横向对比、储蓄险选型、高客传承、核保敏感处理与建议书生成。三个包共用同一 monorepo，故合并为一条词条。对 RIAA：这是「保险实务专家知识如何被封装成可运行 agent」的中文样本——偿付能力、EV、财务结构这些正是精算与公司经营方向的核心议题；与本 wiki 的 [[deepseek-harness]]、[[dsh-plugin-toolkit]]（插件开发工具包）同栈，可与 [[aria-actuarial-agent]]（精算编码 Agent）、[[insurance-agentic-medical]] 等对照阅读；做经营分析时数据侧可接 [[nfra-statistics]] 与 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]。注意：仓库星标为 0（新项目，仅两个仓库），价值判断基于其已发布包与方法论披露，而非采用度。
e.body_en: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts (MIT, TypeScript, created 2026-08-18 / updated 2026-09-04) packages three insurance domain expert agents as **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins** and publishes them to npm — the same runtime this wiki runs on, so they can be loaded and tried directly: (1) `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-company-analyst` (v1.0.1): insurer financial and operating analysis — profit & loss / balance-sheet structure breakdown, solvency ratio and risk-rating tracking, asset-side allocation and impairments, channel analysis and peer benchmarking; (2) `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-ops-analyst` (v1.0.1): operations analyst (codenamed "Ying’an") with five-dimension calculation — core/comprehensive solvency ratios, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance; (3) `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-product-analyst` (v1.8.4, 2026-09-10): product and proposal expert ("InsureGuide") covering clause analysis, value-for-money, product comparison, savings-product selection, HNW succession, underwriting-sensitive handling and proposal generation. The three packages share one monorepo, so they are recorded as a single entry. For RIAA: a Chinese-language sample of how insurance practice expertise is packaged into runnable agents — solvency, EV and financial structure are exactly the core topics of actuarial and company-operations work; it is on the same stack as [[deepseek-harness]] and [[dsh-plugin-toolkit]] (the plugin development toolkit) and can be read against [[aria-actuarial-agent]] (actuarial coding agent) and [[insurance-agentic-medical]]; for operational analysis the data side connects to [[nfra-statistics]] and [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]. Note: the repository has 0 stars (new project, only two repos) — the judgement rests on its published packages and disclosed methodology, not on adoption.
e.body_hk: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts（MIT，TypeScript，2026-08-18 建倉 / 2026-09-04 更新）把三個保險領域專家 agent 封裝成 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**並發布到 npm——與本 wiki 所用執行時同源，可直接加載試用：① `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-company-analyst`（v1.0.1）：保險公司財務經營分析，做利潤表/資產負債表結構拆解、償付能力充足率與風險評級跟蹤、投資端資產配置與減值、渠道分析與同業對標；② `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-ops-analyst`（v1.0.1）：經營分析（代號「盈安」），五維測算——核心/綜合償付能力充足率、盈利能力、內含價值（EV）、投資風險、監管合規；③ `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-product-analyst`（v1.8.4，2026-09-10）：產品分析與建議書（代號「險析君」）。三個包共用同一 monorepo，故合併為一條詞條。對 RIAA：這是「保險實務專家知識如何被封裝成可運行 agent」的中文樣本——償付能力、EV、財務結構正是精算與公司經營方向的核心議題；與 [[deepseek-harness]]、[[dsh-plugin-toolkit]] 同棧，可與 [[aria-actuarial-agent]]、[[insurance-agentic-medical]] 對照閱讀；做經營分析時數據側可接 [[nfra-statistics]] 與 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]。注意：倉庫星標為 0（新項目），價值判斷基於其已發布包與方法論披露，而非採用度。
